value: codex_context default-tier overflow (>~25k tokens / ~68KB) is two stacked causes, not one. (1) Project resolution silently failing → scope:auto falls through to global, so project-shaped writes accumulate in the user's global store rather than .codexcli/. (2) Once accumulating in global, write-amplification (same key 4-7× per session) inflates byte count faster than entry count suggests. The 2026-05-05 FA-iOS incident: 5 sessions wrote FA-iOS keys (files.icon_detail_view, context.uikit_canimport_pattern, etc.) with project:null → all landed in global. Default-tier bootstrap grew 16K→28K→48K→56K→61K→65K→68K over 8 days. The [project: NONE — auto-scope writes will fall through to global] banner was visible the whole time but is informational only — agents don't act on it. Fix path: refuse codex_set on project:null unless scope is explicit, OR ancestor-walk for .codexcli/. See docs/investigation-bootstrap-overflow-2026-05-05.md + docs/dataset-2026-05-05-findings.md.
